text: Honestly, I was sad. When I heard my son would marry next year and take his wife's last name, I did not like it. He will live near her parents' home, far from us. When he said he would change his last name too, I felt my son was moving away. I was very upset. But was the last name change the only thing I disliked? I think I really wanted him to stay close. Someone said that was an old-fashioned way to think. I think they were right. I need to let my son go, don't I? I still feel sad, but I want to accept his choice. I want to be kind to his wife without getting too close, and care about their happiness.
